messages:
Ops Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeouts for /v1/generate across eu-west-1 and us-east-1. p95 has jumped from ~220ms to 2.1s, p99 ~7.8s. Error rate (5xx) at 8.3% last 5m. Trigger: latency-regression-rule. Link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/1831002468
Jen Park: I'm on it. Paging Marc + SREs. Oncall here.
Marc Liu: seeing it, joining. Was there a rollout around that window?
Deploy Bot: deploy complete: runtime-service @ runtime-v2 deployed at 2026-03-14T13:02:10Z by ci/cd (commit: 4f2b7a3). Canary passed smoke tests.
Liz Ortega: autoscaler logs show a spike in queue depth 13:02:45Z -> 13:06:00Z, then several worker restarts. Could be memory pressure.
Jen Park: Priya, can you drop a short customer-impact note?
Priya Kapoor: early indications: latency affecting interactive chat features for a subset of customers on Dedicated and Hosted. Estimated impacted requests: ~120k over last 10m. Potentially affecting SLA for 3 customers.
Dave Chen: tailing runtime logs now. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T13:03:12Z runtime-v2[worker-7]: WARN request_id=abc timeout waiting for kv-cache response after 500ms
2026-03-14T13:03:15Z runtime-v2[worker-7]: ERROR request_id=abc upstream gateway timeout (504) seq=1024
2026-03-14T13:04:02Z runtime-v2[worker-9]: ERROR oom-kill invoked, killed process pid=22345
```

Dave Chen: seeing oom kills on several pods, then kube restarts.
Marc Liu: hmm runtime-v2 includes a new attention kernel that uses more pinned memory per shard. Looks like memory growth under certain sequence lengths.
Jen Park: can we quickly verify if traffic routing to runtime-v1 still works?
Deploy Bot: active routing: 85% -> runtime-v2, 15% -> runtime-v1.
Marc Liu: reduce traffic to runtime-v2 to 0% for rollback test. Command: `redwoodctl routing set runtime-service --variant runtime-v2=0 --variant runtime-v1=100`
Jen Park: executing now.
Jen Park: done. Waiting on metrics.
Ops Bot: ROUTING CHANGE: traffic shift from runtime-v2 -> runtime-v1 completed at 2026-03-14T13:08:21Z.
Liz Ortega: raw metrics: p95 back to ~240ms within 90s of traffic shift, p99 down to ~400ms. 5xx dropped to 0.6%.
Priya Kapoor: great — start drafting a short status for customers: "experienced elevated errors and latencies after a runtime rollout, rollback in progress, mitigation applied, monitoring". I'll refine.
Marc Liu: we should rollback fully and then cut a hotfix branch to address memory usage in v2. Reverting runtime-v2 -> runtime-v1.5. Command: `redwoodctl rollout undo runtime-service --to runtime-v1.5`
Deploy Bot: rollout started: reverting to runtime-v1.5. Estimated completion 2m.
Oncall Pager: paging followup: Ops will stay for 1h post-rollback and then handoff.
Dave Chen: adding temporary autoscaler safeguard: max replicas cap at 40 to avoid noisy restarts while investigating.
Jen Park: can someone grab the exact commit diff that adds the new kernel? Marc?
Marc Liu: on it — pushing link: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/4f2b7a3 and I'll annotate likely culprit.
Marc Liu: preliminary root cause: new kernel allocates per-sequence pinned buffers and doesn't respect reuse pooling for sequences < 512 tokens — causing leak under mixed sequence workloads.
Priya Kapoor: customer note v0.2 posted to status page: "We observed increased errors/latency following a runtime rollout. We have rolled back to the previous serving version and are monitoring. No customer data exposure detected. Updates to follow."
Jen Park: metrics look stable. p99 at 380ms now, 5xx < 1% sustained for 10m.
Samira Reddy: I'll pick this up for post-incident follow-up and create a postmortem doc. Also will coordinate with runtime team for a canary plan that includes memory stress tests.
Liz Ortega: action items: (1) follow up on kernel pooling fix (Marc), (2) expand canary test to include mixed sequence load (QA), (3) add autoscaler circuit-breaker for rapid OOM patterns (SRE), (4) update rollout playbook to allow faster automatic traffic rollback if p99 > 3s.
Jen Park: thanks everyone. Handing off monitoring to Samira. I'll update the incident thread with final summary in 30m.
Samira Reddy: acknowledged. I'll keep the oncall badge.
Ops Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: rollback completed and primary metric recovery confirmed at 2026-03-14T13:12:50Z. Incident severity: mitigated.
Jen Park: closing note for now: mitigated by rollback, immediate customer impact reduced. Postmortem owners: Samira (lead), Marc (root cause), Liz (sre mitigations).
Dave Chen: saved logs + OOM traces to /var/incidents/1831002468/artifacts.tar.gz and put presigned link in the postmortem.
Priya Kapoor: customer comms scheduled for 13:40Z.
Deploy Bot: deploy/revert audit: runtime-v2 -> runtime-v1.5 (completed).
Samira Reddy: tracking follow-ups in /docs/incidents/1831002468-postmortem.md. Will ping the doc once it's live.
Ops Bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: monitoring handoff complete at 2026-03-14T13:28:00Z. :white_check_mark:
